visualContainers.config: {"name":"4e867d3dc6b982ab03bc","layouts":[{"id":0,"position":{"x":12.31527093596059,"y":88.66995073891626,"z":2000,"width":1256.1576354679803,"height":1246.3054187192117,"tabOrder":0}}],"singleVisual":{"visualType":"textbox","drillFilterOtherVisuals":true,"objects":{"general":[{"properties":{"paragraphs":[{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Care Home Population and Data","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"[PowerBI_Reporting].[dbo].[Care_Home_Patients_PC_Data_v4]"}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"For this report patients are defined as living in a care home if they have live in a CQC care home, this is identified via their primary care coding.","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold"}},{"value":" If a patient is coded using various assigned codes for living in a CQC care home then that patient is defined as living in a care home for this report. A date is assigned to when a patient is living in a care home from based on the date the SNOMED code is recorded. The SNOMED codes used to classify that a patient is living in a care home are: Lives in a residential home (394923006), Lives in care home (248171000000108), Lives in nursing home (160734000). "}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"These are the SNOMED codes included in the PCN DES EHCH specification, and therefore patients included in this report are listed as living in a care home as according to the PCN DES. "},{"value":"This should mean that all care home patient activity recorded is for CQC care homes, as these are the care homes covered by the PCN DES.","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold"}},{"value":" "},{"value":"Some care homes, and therefore activity, in this report are listed as non-CQC homes, this is largely due to the fact that a care home was CQC registered and then was re-registered.","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold"}},{"value":" The activity at the time the care home was registered would be for a CQC home, however they are now considered a non-CQC home. Unfortunately due to coding limitations it is not currently possible to list the care homes as their previous care home category, from before their de-registration and non-CQC status. "}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Other issues such as being unable to align SWAST recorded care home names and CQC recorded names, potential issues with primary care coding in which patients are incorrectly coded as living in a CQC home where instead they are living in a non-CQC home can lead to the inclusion of non-CQC activity within this report.  "}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"The SWAST team recorded whether a patient lives in a care home or not, however due to coding errors or a mismatch in alignment on what is considered a care home between the SWAST team and the CQC list of care homes, not all patients considered to be care home residents are recorded as living in a care home by SWAST. This results in not all SWAST activity for patients listed as living in a CQC care home by primary care as being recorded as care home activity. As primary care coding is the foundation for identifying care home residents for this report, then some SWAST activity is listed as non-care home by their recording but will be included in this report and labelled as care home activity."}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"If a patient has one of the following SNOMED codes recorded then they are recorded as no longer living in a care home from that date onwards, unless one of the three previous SNOMED codes are recorded in the future, in which case a new instance of that patient living in a care home will be recorded.  The codes for recording a patient to be no longer living in a care home are: Died in learning disability unit (713050009), Lives in own home (160943002), Lives in supported home (224220007), Living temporarily in care home (1240291000000104), Moving to new residence (360875003), Patient died in care home (698747008), Patient died in residential institution (818961000000101), Patient died (397709008). "}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"For example if Patient X has "},{"value":"Lives in care home (248171000000108) coded on the 1st of January 2022 and then Patient died (397709008) on the 1st of October 2022, then this patient will be classified as living in a care home from January until October. Therefore any activity in between those dates will be included within the care home data, however any activity for this patient before January 2022 will not be included as the patient was not recorded as living in a care home until that date.","textStyle":{"fontSize":"13.3333px"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Another example is Patient Y, they have Lives in nursing home (160734000) recorded on the 1st of July 2022 and then Lives in own home (160943002) recorded on the 1st of December 2022. Then they have Lives in a residential home (394923006) recorded on the 1st of March 2023 and no other code recorded since then. For this patient they will be classified as living in a care home from July 2022 until December 2022, and then from March 2023 until present. Any activity that patient has between July and December 2022 will be included within the care home data, but if they were to have a SWAST call on the 1st of February 2023, this would not be included as the patient was not recorded as living in a care home at that point. From March 2023 any activity they have will be recorded as care home patient activity until a SNOMED code indicates they no longer live in a care home and/or the patient has died.","textStyle":{"fontSize":"13.3333px"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Falls","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"The weekly and daily falls training graphs relate to a comparison of SWAST calls for falls between two period: pre-training and post-training. The pre-training period covers the 12 months prior to their training, or the first date in which the care home recorded a SWAST, whichever is less recent. The post-training period covers from their training date until the current the date our SWAST data is up to at the time of the this report being published. The rate of SWAST activity is divided by the number of weeks and days in the pre and post-training period to calculate an average daily and weekly rate comparing the two periods. This is visualised as an average care home daily and weekly rate and a care home total daily daily and weekly rate. The average care home rates are an average care homes number of SWAST calls each day or week, whereas the care home total rates are the total number of calls for all care homes each day or week.","textStyle":{"color":"black"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"SWASFT Data ","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold","fontFamily":"Arial"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"[CCG_Current].[SWASFT].[vw_AmbulanceServicePatient]"}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"SWASFT are Gloucestershire's ambulance provider and the data set includes a flag for whether the patient is in a care home and the name of the care home. Currently all data is built using the SWASFT data set as a base, and then linked into national SUS A&E and Admissions data. "}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"CQC Data","textStyle":{"fontWeight":"bold"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Care home names and number of beds is from https://www.cqc.org.uk/about-us/transparency/using-cqc-data [CQC Care Directory.csv]"}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"In the slicer, there are (blank) where the SWASFT care home name was not linkable to the CQC list and 'Closed' where the care home has since closed but the data is included for completeness."}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]}]}}]},"vcObjects":{"title":[{"properties":{"titleWrap":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"true"}}}}}],"background":[{"properties":{"show":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"true"}}},"transparency":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"0D"}}}}}],"general":[{"properties":{"keepLayerOrder":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"true"}}}}}],"visualHeader":[{"properties":{"show":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"false"}}},"transparency":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"0D"}}}}}],"border":[{"properties":{"radius":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"0D"}}}}}]}}}
